diagnosis: VendorContractDataTableView includes sensitive internal governance columns (internal_risk_score, total_liability_cap) in its columns definition. Even though get_initial_queryset filters by assigned vendors, external contractor users can view confidential internal risk assessment ratings and financial liability thresholds meant solely for internal risk officers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/datatables/vendors/?draw=1&start=0&length=10&search[value]= HTTP/1.1
Host: vendorportal.megacorp.com
Cookie: sessionid=external_vendor_session
Accept: application/json
